levels.surface: أحمد بن عمرو بن السرح المصري

notes: Urwa asks Aisha («أنه سأل عائشة») and she answers: she is the last link of the saying (rule 5, 6).
«قال يونس وقال ربيعة في قول الله» gives a second saying (Rabi'a's exegesis) with its own transmission, so it is flagged (rule 11) and not written as a route.
